definitions.explanation: To allow hair, beard, or plants to develop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|は}やす⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べている→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking into ways to regrow hair with medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦ころ→ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ひげ→ひげ：01332_hige⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|は}やして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My father has had a beard since he was young.

examples.japanese: ⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|は}やしたままにしておく⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧よく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It's not good to leave weeds growing in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ひげ→ひげ：01332_hige⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|は}やした⟦そうだ→そうだ：10076_souda⟧。
examples.english: I heard that actor grew a beard for his role.

notes:
{生|は}やす is a godan verb meaning to grow (hair, beard, etc.) deliberately.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pair: ⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧ (intransitive: to grow naturally)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦ひげ→ひげ：01332_hige⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|は}やす: to grow a beard
- ⟦{根|ね}→根：03525_ne⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|は}やす: to put down roots (also figurative)

USAGE:
Implies intentional or deliberate growth, unlike ⟦{生|は}える→生える：02392_haeru⟧ which describes natural, spontaneous growth. {生|は}やす suggests agency—the person chooses to let something grow.

WATCH OUT:
To let hair or nails grow longer, use ⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧, ⟦{爪|つめ}→爪：02159_tsume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧. ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|は}やす means getting hair to grow where there is none.
